The article with the most rule titles containing "witnesses" is almost certainly Article VI (it even bears the title "Witnesses"). The first rule in Article VI is Rule 601 – Competency to Testify in General. Next step: examine the last amendment note for Rule 601 on Cornell LII and identify the deleted word.
